lesson.emptyTitle: Add a lesson title and summary
lesson.emptyHint: Help parents and students understand what this class covered.
lesson.editorHint: Shared with every graded student and their family. Individual feedback stays in the grade table.
lesson.manualHint: Type the final title and summary on the right. No AI credit is used, and you can save grades without any lesson text.
lesson.factsPlaceholder: Describe the lesson facts: what was learned, practiced and produced. Do not include student names or marks.
lesson.preferencesPlaceholder: e.g. keep it under 80 words, use 3 bullets, write in Arabic
lesson.aiPrivacy: Only your lesson description is sent to the AI. Student names, marks and remarks are never included.
lesson.fileHint: One PDF with selectable text, up to 10 MB. Scanned PDFs without selectable text cannot be read.
lesson.imageGate: Photo transcription (JPG/PNG/WebP) is not enabled for grade entry yet: photos can contain student personal data. Use a text PDF or write the summary yourself.
lesson.truncated: The material was long, so only the first 30,000 characters were read. Mention anything important that was cut in your note below.
lesson.fileFactsLabel: What did you actually cover from this material?
lesson.fileFactsPlaceholder: e.g. we only did pages 12–13 and the pair discussion, not the homework section
lesson.linkedHint: Copy the title and summary from one of your lesson plans for this class and subject. The copy is independent: later plan edits will not change saved grades.
lesson.noPlans: No lesson plans found for this class and subject.
lesson.planDateMismatch: This plan has a different date than the grade entry. Check that it is the right lesson before using it.
lesson.summaryLabel: Lesson summary for parents and students
lesson.summaryHint: About 60–100 words or 2–4 short bullets works best. Plain text only. A summary needs a title; a title alone is fine.
lesson.titleRequired: Add a lesson title before saving a lesson summary.
lesson.requestFailed: The request failed. Your grades and text are kept — try again or write the summary yourself.
lesson.factsRequired: Describe what actually happened in class before drafting. A style request alone is not enough.
lesson.scopeConfirm: Changing the class or subject clears the shared lesson title and summary. Continue?
lesson.dateConfirm: The lesson date changed. Clear the shared lesson title and summary? Press Cancel to keep them for the new date.
